title: Energy OT Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) — v1.0
description: A per-asset cryptographic inventory record for energy-sector OT devices and identity infrastructure, adapted from the CycloneDX Cryptographic Bill of Materials concept (see docs/CODEBOOK.md for field-by-field provenance) for utilities that need a flat, spreadsheet-friendly starting point ahead of any CISA CBOM guidance (expected under EO 14412, ~2026-12-19; reconcile this template against that guidance once published).

asset_id.description: Unique identifier for the physical or logical asset (device serial, hostname, or utility asset-tag). Never include personally identifying information.

asset_type.description: Category of the device or system carrying this cryptographic dependency.

protocol.description: The wire protocol or standard this cryptographic dependency belongs to. See data/processed/crosswalk.csv for the reference mapping.

crypto_function.description: The cryptographic role this algorithm plays, matching the crosswalk's unit of analysis.

algorithm.description: The specific algorithm and parameter set in use today, e.g. 'RSA-2048', 'ECDSA-P256', 'AES-256-GCM', 'HMAC-SHA256'.

key_or_hash_size_bits.description: Key length (asymmetric/symmetric) or hash/MAC output size in bits.

quantum_vulnerable.description: yes_shor = broken by a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (RSA, ECC/ECDSA/ECDH); yes_grover_margin_only = symmetric primitive whose effective security is halved by Grover's algorithm but which remains usable at doubled key size (AES-256, SHA-384/512); no = not a cryptographic primitive at quantum risk.

pqc_replacement_reference.description: FIPS reference for the intended replacement/hybrid, e.g. 'FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-768)', 'FIPS 204 (ML-DSA-65)', 'FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s)', or 'n/a - not quantum-vulnerable'.

vendor_pqc_support.description: Whether the device/software vendor has shipped, committed to, or given no indication of PQC support.

pqc_migration_status.description: This asset's own migration status, independent of vendor support.

compensating_control.description: Any compensating control in place while native PQC support is unavailable (e.g., network segmentation, external VPN/TLS tunnel, physical access control). Free text.

driving_deadline_ref.description: Which row of data/processed/timeline.csv (by event_id) this asset's migration is planned against, if any.

notes.description: Free-text notes; do not include vendor-confidential contract terms or anything the utility would not want in a document it might one day share with a regulator or auditor.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date this inventory row was last confirmed accurate.
